status.en: 24 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 20% fewer than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Golan Heights.
status.nb: 24 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 20 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Golanhøydene.

summary.en: Israeli forces have advanced in Quneitra while a Syrian road security officer was killed in Daraa and later received an official funeral. Protesters blocked the Damascus-Suwayda road demanding the release of detainees and condemning repeated Israeli incursions. Shooting attacks in northern Syria wounded three civilians, and a foreign minister met Saudi King Hamad, while Damascus hosted the FORTIX 2026 security and safety expo. The UCDP recorded 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024.
summary.nb: Israelske styrker har rykket frem i Quneitra mens en syrisk veisikkerhetsansatt ble drept i Daraa og senere fikk en offisiell begravelse. Demonstranter blokkerte veien mellom Damaskus og Suwayda og krevde løslatelse av fanger og fordømte gjentatte israelske inntrengninger. Skuddangrep i Nord-Syria såtte tre sivile, og en utenriksminister møtte Saudi-kongen Hamad, mens Damaskus var vertskap for FORTIX 2026 sikkerhets‑ og trygghetsmesse. UCDP registrerte 2 732 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
